integrity: The proof reconstructs all operations from the five original axioms; a standalone exhaustive checker tests the complete finite normal form. Verification is not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Complete classification is proved only for the four-element Boolean lattice. The two F-class operations and an earlier four-element non-Heyting example are previously known and not independently claimed. Equivalent unindexed classifications cannot be excluded.
title: Complete preconditional spectrum on the four-element Boolean lattice
